authority: Structural implementation review; empirical results remain scoped to their retained records.
scope: 23 production workspace owners and auxiliary direction
request-content producer ABI and review-execution transport
Turbo producer outputs and scoped prerequisites

structuralConclusions.productionGraph: Acyclic; no production dependency on tooling or verification.
structuralConclusions.sharedDomains: Explicit domain owners; request-content belongs to agent-flow-bend and review-execution is its declared direct consumer.
structuralConclusions.authority: Bend transition/projector authority and resident process/state authority remain separate; TypeScript executes effects.
structuralConclusions.verticalCapabilities: Installation, rules, review/advice, inspection and activity retain their named owner packages.
structuralConclusions.hook: Dedicated entry composes hook-runtime; protected source and emitted contribution policies reject administration, mutation, parsing and provider execution.
structuralConclusions.pi: Node-hosted extension depends only on runtime-environment; published relative hook path and rewritten runtime assets preserve installed geometry.
structuralConclusions.build: Turbo owns scheduling and cached private artifacts; admission/source drift, actual loader supplier proofs, restored inventories and atomic publication retain independent guarantees.
structuralConclusions.lease: Inherited token requires live owning process plus open matching lease; enclosed groups are registered and drained before release.
structuralConclusions.requestContent: Private producer publishes exactly six ABI/runtime files; wrapper-only projector access, copied inspection bytes and disabled ambient trace preserve accepted content contract.
structuralConclusions.installation: Launcher, retained root coordinates and native/prebuilt paths agree; PR241 remains administration/install ownership.
structuralConclusions.cleanup: No duplicate root request-content generated copies or superseded assembly cache/manual scheduling implementation found.

empirical.archiveInventory: Read-only actual tar inventory agrees with both targets, five commands each, Pi assets, native suppliers and seven defaults.
empirical.buildAcceptance: Parent reports 35 terminal cases across retained candidates; these do not substitute for final installed cells.
empirical.startup: Retained final installed comparison; host/load/runtime and artifact scope remain bounded.
empirical.claude: Actual installed same-archive record demonstrates controlled TypeScript adoption with zero Jev.
empirical.codex: Retained real-host log independently parses to realCodex:passed and clean-package-and-real-host-passed; current ordinary-clean JSON does not retain that real-host cell.
empirical.pi: Pending: same-profile OAuth refresh invalid_grant before product execution; no success claim.
empirical.fullQuality: Pending; not run by this reviewer.
empirical.darwin: Cross-built/format evidence does not establish actual target-host execution.

limitations: Read-only architectural review, no builds/tests or new runtime probes.
No global platform or latency claim.
Dirty documentation/fixture work remains separately owned by root; final gate candidate must be frozen.
Current clean-package JSON is a later ordinary-clean record; retain the real Codex terminal record separately rather than presenting it as that cell.
